column1: # roster.tsv -- the ONE list of ycpss91255-docker repos (refs #272).
# This file replaced four copies that had already diverged:
# batch-base-upgrade.sh's DEFAULT_REPOS listed app/realsense_ros2 as active,
# check-template-versions.sh had the same repo commented out with a
# CONTRADICTING note, sync-org-repo-settings.sh hardcoded a third list, and
# .claude/commands/pr.md carried a fourth inline. The consequence was a fanout
# whose verification step iterated 2 repos while the upgrader had opened PRs
# for 3, and `--expect` exited 0 regardless, because it only ever looped over
# its own list. Divergence needs two copies; keep it at one.
# HOW THE realsense_ros2 CONTRADICTION WAS RESOLVED. The two notes disagreed
# about whether its template -> .base subtree migration had happened. It has:
# ycpss91255-docker/realsense_ros2's main carries `.base/.version`, and the
# re-add landed deliberately in #199 ("re-add realsense_ros2 to DEFAULT_REPOS
# after rename") with #238 updating the note again. check-template-versions.sh
# never got either edit, so its comment was simply the older of the two. The
# upgrader's state -- active -- is the current one, and the same probe shows
# every parked downstream ALSO already carries `.base`, so "pending the
# template -> .base migration" is stale wherever it still appears; the parked
# entries below now record the reason that is actually still true (archive
# pending / rename pending), not that one.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated; no tabs inside a field):
#   repo      GitHub repo name under ycpss91255-docker.
#   path      Workspace-relative checkout, for the tooling that iterates by
#             path. `-` when no tooling here iterates that repo by path.
#   fanout    active | parked | n-a -- scope of the `.base` subtree fanout
#             (batch-base-upgrade.sh opens the PRs, check-template-versions.sh
#             verifies them; they MUST see the same set, which is the point).
#             `n-a` = not a `.base` consumer at all.
#   mutation  yes | no -- default scope of the generic cross-repo mutation
#             engine (batch-mutation-pr.sh and its presets). Wider than the
#             fanout: it includes `template`, whose subtree is reseeded by
#             init.sh rather than by the upgrade fanout.
#   settings  yes | no -- in scope for sync-org-repo-settings.sh.
#   check     Required status-check context on main. `-` = none required.
#   note      Why this row is in the state it is in.
# Adding a repo to the org means adding a row here; nothing else has a list to
# forget to update.
